build_decoder_model: build a GPT-like autoregressive decoder model using TransformerWrapper and AutoregressiveWrapper from x-transformers
create_text_dataset: create a TextSamplerDataset that samples random sequences of a given length from a tensor of byte data
train_language_model: train a language model with gradient accumulation, mixed precision via accelerate, and configurable learning rate
validate_length_extrapolation: validate model loss across multiple sequence lengths to test length extrapolation capability
generate_text_samples: generate autoregressive text samples from the trained decoder model using kv-caching
